content: React Router (currently react-router@8.3.0 / react-router-dom@7.18.2) supports a 'declarative mode' (BrowserRouter + Routes/Route/Link, client-only, no @react-router/dev framework plugin, no SSR) that layers cleanly onto an existing Vite SPA -- this is distinct from 'framework mode' which replaces the Vite React plugin and adds build-time route conventions/SSR, unnecessary for this app. Declarative mode gives real URLs per destination/sub-view (deep-linkable, back/forward, shareable) while keeping the existing Vite setup untouched.
